name: THE LIVERY MAN
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the floor just right of the pen, clear of the mules, facing him (errata 88 C).
note: THE LIVERY MAN, never named. No document describes his looks; he is drawn as room-15's composition master drew him -- old, lean, a battered hat, braces -- tipped back in a kitchen chair against the wall, facing Grievance's stall (doc 54: the chair 'faces Grievance's stall'; 'He is tipped back on two chair legs'). Five poses in his chair on magenta, generated against a side-by-side with Thad (room-15 operation 3), cut by tools/art/room15-figures.py and drawn over the plate's empty chair. Present in every act.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for the livery man.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, tipped back · 1 breath (derived from rest by tools/rig/ambient-breath.py) · 2 humming, eyes shut · 3 talking · 4 the hat brim pulled down. Breathing on 0 and 1 at `rate`; every `breakEvery` seconds one break from the pool -- humming or the hat (errata 35 and 77: a deliberate action at least every 30 s). He talks on 3.
